result_text:
In the landscape analysis, the "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects unmatched contributors who are active.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java` (around line 104). An unmatched contributor joins the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Configured teams are untouched, since the matching branch runs before this check.

Blank latest-commit dates need no extra code: `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so those contributors count as active.

I compiled `codeanalyzer` and ran the `*Landscape*` and `*Contributor*` tests offline; the run printed no errors. No existing test covers this class, so the new filter is verified by reading only, not by a test. Nothing is committed.
